issues.name: Make Ghibli registry more standard shadcn
issues.description: Simplify the Ghibli component library so its public registry payload behaves more like a conventional shadcn registry: each item declares the packages it actually imports, global style payloads stay narrowly scoped to reusable theme/tokens, optional runtime features are split out, core interactive primitives lean on the same Radix primitives shadcn uses, generated registry output cannot serve stale removed items, and the internal monorepo convenience package does not blur the source-copy registry model.
tasks: [x] Audit every registry item for real package imports and move package dependencies out of `@ghibli/style` into the exact items that import them
[x] Keep `@ghibli/style` focused on style concerns only: theme tokens, base layer, required global utilities, and any style-only dependency such as `tw-animate-css`

[x] Move docs/showcase/app-specific CSS helpers such as `.app-backdrop`, `.ghibli-prose`, and `.ghibli-wash` out of the mandatory `@ghibli/style` payload unless they are required by installed registry components
[x] Split `@ghibli/theme` into a minimal theme provider/runtime item and optional add-ons for non-essential behavior such as UI sound effects
[x] Ensure optional theme sound behavior installs or documents its required public assets; avoid shipping registry code that assumes `/audio/*.mp3` exists without providing a clear install path
[x] Replace custom interactive primitive implementations with shadcn-standard Radix primitives where appropriate, starting with accordion, dropdown-menu, and tooltip
[x] Preserve Ghibli visual styling while aligning the public component API shape with the corresponding shadcn/Radix component conventions

[x] Add a clean step to `pnpm registry:build` so `apps/web/public/r` is deleted before `shadcn build --output apps/web/public/r` runs, preventing stale removed registry items from being served locally
[x] Re-evaluate `packages/ui`: either keep it explicitly internal-only for docs/storybook ergonomics or remove it and import registry sources directly from the docs app
[x] Update README/AGENTS docs to clarify the public contract after the cleanup: install via shadcn registry source copy, not npm package imports
[x] Run verification: `pnpm registry:build`, `pnpm smoke:registry`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, and focused browser/docs checks for representative installed items

issues.name: Move reusable Cozy UI back into Ghibli and make Cozy a registry mirror where possible
issues.description: Audit Cozy Art's frontend for reusable presentation code that has drifted ahead of the Ghibli registry, move the shared pieces into Ghibli as installable registry items, and then re-import them into Cozy Art so Cozy mirrors the registry output wherever practical. Product behavior, backend/API contracts, billing/auth/generation logic, route semantics, and Cozy-specific copy should remain in Cozy Art.
tasks:
[x] Inventory Cozy Art files that correspond to Ghibli registry items
  - Compared `~/cozy/cozy-art/frontend/src/components/ui/**`, `src/components/blocks/**`, `src/theme/**`, and shared visual helpers against `registry/ghibli/**`
  - Classified existing theme runtime files as pure mirrors, `ThemeFrame`/frame config and toast as reusable forks to upstream, app-bundled sound sources as Cozy-only for now, and product blocks/routes as legitimate Cozy-only code

[x] Define the mirror boundary explicitly
  - Ghibli owns reusable UI primitives, generic blocks, theme runtime, tokens, visual frame helpers, optional sound helpers/assets, and presentation-only patterns
  - Cozy Art owns product routes, auth/account/billing/generation behavior, API clients, feature flags, domain copy, app-bundled media imports, and backend contracts

[x] Move generic `ThemeFrame` infrastructure into Ghibli if it is presentation-only
  - Ported `ThemeFrame`, `ThemeRule`, and reusable frame variant configuration into `registry/ghibli`
  - Kept it as a reusable presentation preset layer over `HandDrawnFrame`; Cozy can tune the copied config after installation if needed
  - Added registry entries, exports, showcase examples, and tests

[x] Evaluate toast UI for upstreaming
  - Added the generic toast implementation to Ghibli as an installable registry UI item
  - Kept product notification copy in Cozy Art; the upstream event channel is library-scoped
  - Ready for Cozy re-import after upstream verification

[x] Review account/community/generate visual blocks for reusable slices
  - Reviewed the current account/community/generate files and kept product-owned blocks in Cozy because they still include route semantics, domain copy, data shape assumptions, model semantics, or auth/billing behavior
  - Deferred broader block extraction until those surfaces can be renamed and separated from Cozy-specific behavior

[x] Move reusable theme assets/helpers into Ghibli where appropriate
  - Moved reusable frame configuration into `registry/ghibli/lib/theme/theme-frame-config.ts`
  - Left app-bundled sound imports in Cozy for now; Ghibli's optional `theme-sounds` item remains public-asset based and documented as optional

[x] Update Ghibli registry contract for every upstreamed item
  - Added canonical sources under `registry/ghibli/**`
  - Added `registry.json` entries and registry dependencies for `@ghibli/theme-frame` and `@ghibli/toast`
  - Added `packages/ui/src/index.ts` exports for docs/storybook only
  - Regenerated `apps/web/public/r` with `pnpm registry:build`

[x] Update Ghibli docs/showcase
  - Added installable showcase specimens for `theme-frame` and `toast`
  - Kept Cozy-specific examples under `apps/web/src/cozy-examples/**` and clearly non-installable

[x] Re-import upstreamed items into Cozy Art through shadcn
  - Ran `shadcn add @ghibli/theme @ghibli/theme-frame @ghibli/toast --overwrite --yes` against the local registry server, then re-imported `@ghibli/theme @ghibli/theme-frame` after splitting `ThemeContext`
  - Used item-by-item imports instead of blind `@ghibli/all`
  - Reviewed overwrites and kept product-owned Cozy files outside the registry import

[x] Reduce Cozy Art local forks after re-import
  - Removed duplicated local theme runtime and frame configuration files now mirrored from Ghibli under `src/lib/theme/**`
  - Kept app-owned sound-effect source mapping in `src/theme/theme-sound-effects.ts` because it imports bundled Cozy audio assets
  - Updated Cozy imports so `ThemeFrame`, `useTheme`, and `ThemeProvider` all use the same Ghibli-mirrored theme context

[x] Add verification for both repos
  - Ghibli: ran `pnpm registry:build`, `pnpm build:web`, `pnpm smoke:registry`, `pnpm --filter @ghibli/web typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm --filter @ghibli/web lint`, and `pnpm --filter @ghibli/web test:e2e -- docs.spec.ts`
  - Cozy Art frontend: ran `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm test`, targeted lint on imported/theme files, `git diff --check` on touched import files, and a browser smoke against local preview

[x] Document the ongoing lifecycle
  - Shared UI changes happen in Ghibli first
  - Cozy pulls changes with explicit `shadcn add @ghibli/<item> --overwrite`
  - Builds never auto-refresh copied registry source from the internet
